title: CCZ classes of non-Gold APN monomials
summary: Classify every function CCZ-equivalent to a non-Gold APN monomial by the EA classes of the monomial and, when defined, its inverse.

formal_statement.body: Let $F(x)=x^d$ be a non-Gold APN monomial on $\mathbb F_{2^n}$. Is every function $G$ that is CCZ-equivalent to $F$ EA-equivalent either to $F$ or, when $F$ is a permutation, to $F^{-1}$? Equivalently, prove the proposed equality of classes throughout the stated scope, or exhibit a CCZ-equivalent $G$ outside both EA classes.

scope.domain: CCZ and EA equivalence classes of non-Gold APN monomials over binary finite fields
assumptions: The inverse branch applies only when $F$ is a permutation
parameters: function $G$ in the CCZ class of $F$
scope.unresolved_remainder: Prove the classification for every non-Gold APN monomial, or produce a function in one of their CCZ classes that belongs to neither proposed EA class.

citations.label: Koelsch, residual non-Gold APN-monomial conjecture
citations.locator: Conjecture 1 and Conclusion, journal pp. 4857 and 4861--4862

provenance.note: The 2021 TIT paper explicitly identifies the statement as Conjecture 4.14 of the 2019 source and resolves only its inverse-function branch.

progress.summary: Budaghyan, Calderini, and Villa state the CCZ-versus-EA classification conjecture for inverse functions and non-Gold APN monomials.
Koelsch proves the inverse-function branch and explicitly leaves the non-Gold APN-monomial branches unanswered.
